AchievementRule.description: A smash or collect rule a world editor added to an achievement.

comment.description: What the editor who made the rule noted.

Source.description: Where a value came from, so guesses stay visible next to what live did.

oneOf.description: Extracted from the game client's data.
Seen in a capture of the live server (LMO_Captures.cap).
Seen in the recorded 2015 demo session.
Taken from video footage of live.
Values the server used before they were moved into content (docs/TUNABLES.md).
Proposed by a tool from client data (navmesh, names, ...), not seen live.
Placed or confirmed by someone in the world editor.

description:
An achievement (the client's lore tree), or a rule-only key (`category:`, `drop:`,
`find:`): `achievements/<slug>.json`.

counter.description: Client stat and the count needed.

extends.description: Another record of the same kind this one starts from: its fields, then this one's on top.

feature.description:
The feature it belongs to: `live` (recreating live), `feature/...` or `other/...`.
A record with the id of one in a parent feature changes it while this feature is on.

id.description: Its id: `achievement/<slug>`. Stable: other records refer to it.

lore.description: The client's lore id (none: a rule-only record).

minifigure_counter.description:
Its reward script counts it on its minifigure (InventoryItemGeneric3 3000114 +1, the
Heroic and Legendary "Complete Any 5/10" go by that count).

parent_lore.description: The client's parent lore id when it isn't an achievement here (2: the tree's root).

rev.description: Revision, raised by every saved edit (for merging concurrent edits).

reward.description:
The reward: a loot bag dropped at the player from this table (the lore node's reward
script, field 7: `spawnloot` of the "Stars Small/Medium/Large/Very Large" tables).
None: `stars` are given directly.

stars.description: AchievementRewardValue: the stars the client shows as the reward.

updated.description: Unix time of the last edit.

title: Achievement
